description: S45 T5 (PM7/PM8): proposal.commit {id, digest} — the digest-bound human decision. effectApplied:true states THIS call applied the effect (false is the crash-recovery completion: the effect had landed, the flip was lost, the retry finished it — the door SAYS so instead of re-applying). before/after are the target's InForceView answers (Render() bytes verbatim, D14; empty here — an mcp_server_add changes no policy target). warnings carry the authoring-time advisory lines the CLI prints on stderr (DEF-038, SEC-014) as DATA for every surface. The row left `proposed`: decided_by_kind='user', decided_by_id = the connection's peer uid (never a param), and exactly one policy_change row (op='commit', ids-only summary) stands behind the decision.
